title: Staff Platform Engineer
requirements: Candidates should have deep, hands-on experience with Go in production systems, and be comfortable owning Kubernetes at scale across multiple clusters and teams. Strong Terraform experience is required, including designing reusable modules that other engineering teams consume directly. Familiarity with gRPC-based service architectures and the operational patterns around them is expected, as is experience building or maintaining observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, distributed tracing). We are looking for someone who has operated at a staff level, setting technical direction for platform reliability across several teams rather than only executing on assigned tickets. Prior experience in a regulated or high-availability environment is a plus but not required.
responsibilities: You will set the technical direction for our platform organization's infrastructure strategy, working across payments, risk, and consumer engineering teams to ensure consistent, reliable infrastructure patterns. Day to day, you will design and evolve our Kubernetes platform, extend our internal Terraform module library, and improve the observability and reliability of our gRPC-based service mesh. You will be the escalation point for the org's most complex infrastructure incidents, drive postmortems to completion, and mentor senior engineers on platform architecture decisions. You will also represent platform engineering in cross-functional planning, influencing how new services are built and deployed company-wide.
construction_rationale: Grade 3: exact title and staff-level scope, full core stack (Go, Kubernetes, Terraform, gRPC) plus secondary tooling, in a fintech setting unrelated to Dave's actual employers.

title: Staff Infrastructure Engineer
requirements: You've shipped and operated real infra at scale — Go is your primary language, you know Kubernetes inside and out (not just kubectl apply, but cluster design, multi-tenancy, upgrade strategy), and you write Terraform that other teams actually want to reuse. You've built or run gRPC services and you know your way around Prometheus and Grafana well enough to design dashboards and alerts from scratch, not just consume someone else's. We're a small, fast-moving team, so you should be comfortable being the most senior infra voice in the room — setting direction, not waiting for it. Bonus points if you've dealt with video or streaming workloads before, though it's genuinely not a requirement.
responsibilities: You'll basically own our infrastructure roadmap — deciding where our Kubernetes platform needs to evolve next, extending our Terraform setup as we add new services, and keeping our gRPC service mesh observable and debuggable as we scale past a few hundred services. You'll pair with product engineering teams to unblock them on infra, jump into gnarly production incidents when they happen, and push back (respectfully) when a proposed architecture is going to bite us later. There's no dedicated infra manager here — you'll be setting technical direction for the whole platform effort.
construction_rationale: Grade 3: exact title and staff-level scope, full core stack present, startup-casual register in a media/streaming setting to vary tone and industry across the grade-3 set.
